description: `provenance` is Void Core's one existing BYTE-level commitment: canonical JSON (object keys sorted, no whitespace, non-ASCII emitted as UTF-8 rather than \u escapes), SHA-256, first 16 hex chars. Pinned here: key order does not matter (values 0 and 1 are the same object written two ways and MUST hash identically); nesting sorts at every level; unicode is not escaped; empty containers are distinguishable from each other and from null. Values 6 and 7 pin the known cross-language hazard — an integer and a float of equal value hash DIFFERENTLY, because `1` and `1.0` are different JSON text. See README.md §4 before putting floats in stamped data.
